scene: Laundry day living room. Buddy tries a dignified quiet escape from a couch covered in clean folded clothes, holding one BLUE SOCK in his mouth. Its mate is tucked into it, so the SECOND BLUE SOCK trails conspicuously along the floor behind his mouth; make two distinct soft socks connected at cuffs, no rope/no snakelike strip. Buddy walks naturally with elongated close-coated torso and all leg roots visible, looking hopeful that nobody noticed. Neet lies satisfied on the warm pile of freshly laundered pale T-shirts on couch behind him, full smooth tan torso and prone forepaws supported by clothing, ears raised at the escape. Cropped human hand at frame edge points toward Buddy, indicating he has been spotted. No human faces, no words, simple lived-in laundry setting. The comedy is failed stealth betrayed by the spare sock.
placement_after: Buddy froze, then bolted, dragging the sock-pair like captured treasure.
alt_text: Buddy’s quiet sock rescue is betrayed by the second blue sock trailing behind him.
